Job Summary: 

A warm and welcoming family is seeking an experienced Housekeeper to join them on the beautiful Isle of Man, an area celebrated for its safety, stunning natural surroundings, and excellent quality of life.

This is the family’s full-time residence, set within extensive grounds and supported by an established outdoor team. The household is busy, friendly, and relaxed, with five children aged 6–17. The role will primarily focus on the younger three children, who split their time between 2 homes. 

Mum is very hands-on and involved in the children’s daily lives. They are looking for a positive, organised, and energetic Housekeeper who genuinely enjoys working with school-age children and can become a supportive, consistent presence in the family.

You will work alongside a friendly and experienced estate team, who will guide you through household systems and routines. This is a collaborative, well-structured, and welcoming environment, ideal for someone who thrives as part of a family team.
 

Job specification:

Housekeeping to a high standard
School runs pick-ups and drop-off and taking the children to different after school events
Supporting morning and after-school routines
Cooking for the children and occasionally the family (simple, family-style meals – not formal cooking) and preparing snacks
Ad hoc childcare during school holidays and evenings
Helping to keep children’s bedrooms, play areas and family spaces organised
Laundry management, general weekly and daily shops. 
Dog care and pet sitting

Candidate specification:

roven experience Housekeeper in a private household
Confident caring for multiple school-age children
A driver is required with a full clean driving licence – car provided for work and personal time
Warm, calm and structured approach
Energetic and organised with good initiative
Happy working within a team environment
Discreet and professional
Excellent, checkable references required
Must be pet friendly and enjoy working in homes with dogs

Enhanced DBS check required at offer stage & and a current First Aid Certificate
Working Days & hours: Five days per week, including weekends on two weeks of the month, 40 hours a week  

Please apply by sending your CV and covering letter to - enquiries@bramden.com

Hartford Homes is seeking an experienced Site Manager and Assistant Site Manager to join our award-winning team and help uphold our unrivalled reputation for building exceptional quality homes in the Isle of Man.

In these key full-time roles, the successful candidates will oversee the day-to-day management of construction sites, ensuring projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and to the highest standards. Responsibilities will include managing daily site operations from inception to completion, coordinating subcontractors, suppliers and site teams, ensuring compliance with health and safety regulations, monitoring quality and project progress, conducting site inspections, resolving on-site issues, and maintaining accurate site records and reports. The roles will also involve liaising with clients, consultants and local authorities when required, as well as leading site meetings and providing regular progress updates.

The ideal candidates will have proven experience in a Site Manager or Assistant Site Manager role within the construction industry, together with strong leadership and team management skills. A good understanding of construction methods and health and safety requirements is essential, along with excellent organisational, communication and problem-solving abilities. Experience in creating and maintaining construction build programmes would be advantageous, as would relevant construction qualifications. Applicants should also be competent in the use of Microsoft Office and site management software and must hold a full driving licence.

To Apply

Please send your CV and cover letter by email or post to jobs@hartford.im or Hartford Homes, Middle River, Douglas, IM2 1AL.

Notes
Quantity Surveyor – Building & Civil Engineering.
Location: Isle of Man.

CCJ Group Limited is seeking an experienced and motivated Quantity Surveyor to support the delivery of building and civil engineering projects across our expanding portfolio.

This is a key position within the business, working closely with the Managing Director and senior management team on a daily basis. The role offers genuine opportunity for progression into senior management as the company continues to grow.

The Role:
The successful candidate will be responsible for the commercial management of projects from inception through to completion, as well as contributing to the company’s estimating and tendering activities. You will work collaboratively with site and contracts teams, taking a hands-on and proactive approach across both pre-construction and delivery phases.

Key Responsibilities:

Commercial management of building and civil engineering projects.
Cost planning, procurement, and subcontractor management.
Preparation and agreement of valuations, variations, and final accounts.
Contract administration under JCT and NEC forms of contract.
Preparation of estimates, tenders, and bid submissions.
Reviewing drawings, specifications, and pricing project risks and oppotunities.
Supporting project teams with practical and commercial problem solving.
Developing and maintaining strong client relationships.

About You:

Driven and proactive with a strong work ethic.
Highly detail-oriented with sound commercial awareness.
Experience in both civil engineering and building projects.
Proven experience in estimating and tendering.
Good working knowledge of JCT and NEC contracts.

WORKS MANAGER – CIVILS & BUILDING

CCJ Group Limited is a growing and ambitious construction and civil engineering company delivering a wide range of projects as Principal Contractor across the Isle of Man, including Building Projects, Civil Engineering, Drainage, Demolition, Earthworks, Infrastructure, Utilities, and Refurbishment Projects.
We are looking for an experienced and driven Works Manager with a strong background across both civils and building projects to join our senior team.
This is not a desk-only management role. We are looking for someone practical, experienced, and confident — someone who understands construction from the ground up and can lead teams, organise operations, maintain standards, and help drive the business forward.
The ideal candidate will:
Have strong experience within the construction industry.
Come from either a trades, engineering, plant, or machinery background.
Be confident managing men, subcontractors, and site operations.
Understand civils, drainage, earthworks, foundations, and general building works.
Be highly organised and capable of managing multiple live operations.
Be driven, motivated, and capable of working within a fast-paced environment.
Be safety-focused, quality-focused, and commercially aware.
Lead by example and maintain high standards across the business.
Work closely with senior management to support long-term business growth.
Help build, develop, and strengthen teams within an increasingly challenging labour market.
CCJ operates its own fleet of machinery, wagons, quarry operations, tools, and labour force, so we need someone who can organise practical operations efficiently while maintaining professionalism and control throughout delivery.
This is a long-term opportunity for the right person, with:
Company vehicle/pick-up.
Competitive salary package.
Paid holidays.
Long-term progression into senior management.
Performance-based uplift opportunities.
The chance to become a key part of a growing and respected local business.
The position is open to both on-island and off-island applicants. Off-island candidates must already hold a valid visa and legal right to work within the UK and the Isle of Man.
We are looking for someone who wants responsibility, takes pride in their work, and wants to help build something long-term.
To apply or enquire confidentially, please contact CCJ Group Limited directly.

Enforce the Laws of the Game:
Apply the IFAB Laws of the Game fairly, consistently, and impartially throughout the match.

Ensure Player Safety:
Protect players by penalising dangerous play, managing physical contact, and stopping play for injuries when required.

Control and Manage the Match:
Maintain discipline, manage tempo, and deal with misconduct using cautions (yellow cards) and send-offs (red cards).

Make Accurate Decisions:
Judge fouls, offsides (where applicable), restarts, goals, and infringements in real time.

Work with the Officiating Team:
Communicate effectively with assistant referees, fourth officials, and VAR (if used).

Manage Player and Team Conduct:
Handle dissent, manage technical areas, and communicate decisions clearly to players and coaches.

Apply Match Procedures:
Conduct pre-match checks (pitch, equipment, players), manage substitutions, keep time, and restart play correctly.

Report and Administration:
Complete match reports, including disciplinary actions, injuries, and incidents, accurately and on time.

Professional Standards:
Maintain fitness, knowledge of law changes, neutrality, and a high standard of behaviour on and off the pitch.

Notes
Akela is a small and growing premium working dog & cat food brand, based on the Isle of Man. Our award-winning grain-free foods have accumulated the below accolades amongst others:
#1 Dog Food - eDogAdvisor (over 700 reviews).
”Best Value 5* Food” - AllAboutDogFood.
Business of Distinction Awards.
Highly Commended - Best Dog Food Brand, Your Dog Magazine.
We are looking for an experienced Customer Service Advisor to:
Process orders.
Advise customers in canine & feline nutrition via telephone and e-mail.
Liaise with parcel carriers to ensure efficient delivery.
Contact current and potential stockists.
Deliver orders to local customers in our small electric van (ideal, not required - currently half a day per week).
Attend occasional shows to exhibit our products as and when required. 
Computer skills, spreadsheets, social media platforms, numeracy and literacy should all be second nature to you. You will need to work well under pressure, dealing with challenging customers at times, so a calm manner is required to avoid being anxious about any pressurised situations that may arise from time to time. We are specifically looking for enthusiastic self-motivated team-players with initiative and a fantastic work ethic. With an impeccable telephone manner and passion for pets, your advice will help puppies thrive on our sublime food resulting in glowing customer reviews. If this sounds like you and you love dogs then get in touch today!
The computer systems we are are Zendesk, Magento and Mintsoft so if you have prior experience with any of those then that would help. If you happen to have marketing, sales or IT skills you may also be able to help further in other areas as we grow.
In return we can offer:
A competitive salary.
Potential bonus for exceeding expectations.
Self-study canine nutrition training.
Discounted pet supplies.
Part-time hours.
8:30am - 3pm working hours Monday, Wednesday & Friday with 30 mins unpaid lunch (evenings, weekends & shows optional).
This role is primarily located at our Head Office in Douglas, Isle of Man. There is a relocation incentive of up to £4,400 available, terms apply.
Please submit your CV and covering letter stating why you wish to work for our business in particular. We have keen eyes for the correct usage of the English language so please use correct grammar and spelling. CVs submitted without covering letters will not be read.

For more details and to apply visit: https://uk.indeed.com/job/customer-service-advisor-04bbfa20633abdc6

Notes
Key Responsibilities
As a Delivery Driver and Warehouse Operative at Pacesetter, you will be primarily responsible for delivering orders to sites across the Isle of Man in a timely and professional manner. You will plan and organise your delivery routes efficiently to make the most of each working day, and ensure that all deliveries are correct and complete against the relevant paperwork. Back at the warehouse, you will unload incoming stock, inspect items for damage and allocate them to the correct orders, as well as providing general support across warehouse operations as needed.

Skills and Experience Required
Applicants must be aged 18 or over and hold a full driving licence, as this is central to the role. We are looking for someone with a positive work history and a strong record of reliable attendance. While not essential, knowledge of tiles or bathroom materials would be an advantage, as would holding a forklift licence. Above all, we are looking for someone dependable, organised and happy to turn their hand to whatever the day requires.

How to Apply
To find out more or to apply, please contact us by phone on 01624 622045 or by email at dan@pacesetter-ltd.com. If you have not heard from us within four weeks of submitting your application, please assume that your application has been unsuccessful on this occasion.

Applicants must have previous childcare experience, a full driving licence and their own vehicle, excellent English, and an enhanced DBS check. 

To apply, please send your CV to jo@recruitmentworks.im or call 629 676 for more information.

Notes
Due to continued growth and the successful award of several new contracts, we are seeking experienced and motivated Electrical Engineers to join our expanding team.

The successful candidates will undertake a varied role covering both planned maintenance and project installation works across a range of commercial and multi-site environments. Duties will include carrying out Planned Preventative Maintenance (PPM) in line with scheduled programmes, responding promptly and effectively to reactive maintenance issues, and delivering electrical installations on both small and large-scale projects. The role will also involve issuing the appropriate electrical certification, including minor works and full installation certificates, diagnosing and resolving electrical faults, and maintaining consistently high standards of safety, workmanship, and customer service at all times.

Applicants should hold the 18th Edition Wiring Regulations qualification together with NVQ Level 2 and 3 in Electro-technical Installation, City & Guilds Parts 2 and 3, or equivalent industry experience.

Candidates must be able to demonstrate strong fault-finding and electrical installation skills, excellent communication and customer-facing abilities, and a proactive, self-motivated approach to work. A full driving licence is essential for this position.

Experience working within commercial or multi-site environments would be advantageous, along with knowledge of periodic testing and inspection and familiarity with business-critical systems.

This is an excellent opportunity to join a growing organisation with a strong pipeline of secured work, offering long-term stability and ongoing career development opportunities.

Why Join Prospero Group?

We offer a competitive salary based on experience, with guaranteed 40-hour weeks with overtime opportunities available. 25 days annual leave, UK and IOM bank holidays and annual birthday leave.  Employees benefit from a company pension scheme, Bupa healthcare, and the provision of a company vehicle and uniform. We are committed to supporting our team through ongoing training and professional development opportunities, helping you build a long-term and rewarding career with us.

To apply, please send your CV to hr@prospero.im. For a confidential discussion about the role, contact us on 01624 695250 or visit https://www.prospero.im/careers/

Swagelok Ltd - Process Engineer - Quality.

Are you an experienced Engineer looking for your next challenge?
We're looking for a driven, hands-on Engineer to help us deliver excellence in manufacturing, drive continuous improvement, and ensure the highest quality standards across our products.
What you'll bring:
? Experience in Process Engineering, Manufacturing or Compliance
? Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
? Knowledge of ISO 9001 / Quality Management Systems
? A passion for continuous improvement
What you'll get:
? £1,000 Sign-On Bonus
? Competitive salary
? Day Shift
? Excellent benefits
? Career development opportunities
? Work for a global engineering leader
About the Role
We are seeking a motivated and technically capable Engineer to join our Quality team. In this role, you will support the development, maintenance, and execution of quality plans, product specifications, and process control systems across new and existing products. You will work hands-on with manufacturing, engineering, and support teams to drive continuous improvement, enhance product quality, and reduce the risk of external escapes.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who is passionate about quality, eager to grow, and excited to make a meaningful impact within a world-class manufacturing environment.

Key Responsibilities:
Develop & maintain quality assurance and process control plans.
Analyse product, process, and measurement system capability.
Support PQP events, gage R&Rs, and validation for new products.
Train teams on quality tools, methods, and requirements.
Drive corrective actions and continuous improvement.
Ensure compliance with ISO 9001, company quality standards, customer requirements, and applicable regulatory obligations through auditing, monitoring, and continuous review of quality system effectiveness.
What We’re Looking For
Technical degree with 3+ years in quality, engineering, or manufacturing.
Experience with ISO 9001 or QMS auditing.
Strong analytical, communication, and problem?solving skills.

Swagelok Ltd

Tool Maker (Twilight Shift)

We are Hiring!

We are looking for an experienced Tool Maker on our twilight shift

Twilight shift (11 am – 21.00 pm working Monday to Thursday)

Toolmaker (Manual Machining & Tool Regrinding)

We are seeking a skilled and self-motivated Toolmaker with a strong background in manual machining and tool reconditioning. This role is focused on precision work using manual lathes and milling machines, alongside surface grinding, tool regrinding, and heat treatment processes.

The successful candidate will demonstrate a high level of craftsmanship and the ability to interpret engineering drawings accurately, while engaging proactively with internal customers to deliver practical, high-quality solutions.

Key Responsibilities:

Manufacture, modify, and repair tooling using manual lathes, milling machines, and grinders.
Independently, re-grind a wide range of cutting tools, including drills, reamers, and similar end-working tools, ensuring accuracy and timely turnaround.
Perform heat treatment processes as required to support tooling performance and longevity.
Carry out maintenance repairs to jigs, make new fixtures, gauges, and other tooling.
Set up and operate all relevant machine tools and equipment safely and efficiently.
Read and interpret technical drawings and specifications with a high degree of accuracy.
Apply problem-solving skills to identify and resolve non-routine tooling or machining issues.
Work collaboratively with customers and colleagues to develop practical and cost-effective solutions.
Skills & Experience

Strong hands-on experience in traditional toolmaking, with a focus on manual machining processes.
Proven ability to re-grind and restore a variety of cutting tools independently.
Competence in surface grinding and heat treatment techniques.
Excellent understanding of engineering drawings, tolerances, and materials.
Ability to work with minimal supervision while maintaining high standards.
Effective communication skills and a customer-focused mindset.
Additional Requirements

Adheres to all plant regulatory and safety requirements.
Supports the company operating plan and aligns with Swagelok’s mission, vision, and values.
About You

This opportunity is ideal for a dedicated professional who takes pride in their work, thrives in a team environment, and consistently delivers high standards in customer service, quality, and cost-effectiveness.

Additional tasks include supporting our maintenance technicians with general upkeep of our facility including CNC machining centres, assisting with machine moves and installation of new equipment.
As a customer facing site, we require the successful candidate to show close attention to detail, to take pride in their work and ensure a high standard is maintained in all aspects of their roll.

This exciting opportunity would suit an individual who thrives in a team environment, whilst achieving high standards of customer service, quality, and cost effectiveness.

We’re looking for someone aged 16+ who’s curious, practical, and eager to learn. You don’t need any experience, just a good attitude and willingness to get stuck in. As you learn and grow, there’s a clear path to more responsibility, qualifications, and a full time skilled role in the AV industry. If you’re interested, just send us your CV to ali@cleervu.com and a few lines about yourself – who you are, why this job sounds good to you, and if you’ve ever done anything with tools, tech, or DIY. As a Finance Assistant, you will provide support to the Group Finance team. 

You may be required to undertake reasonable additional or alternative duties subject to business requirements, duties include but are not limited to:

Maintain accurate and up-to-date financial records, including processing and recording transactions, reconciling accounts, and managing ledgers.
Assist in preparing financial reports, such as balance sheets and income statements in addition to other financial reports & KPI’s. 
Enter financial transactions into internal databases and ensure accuracy.
Managing supplier invoices within accounting software and arranging settlement. 
Create and update expense reports, process reimbursement forms, maintain ledgers and liaise with budget managers. 
Assist in the preparation of monthly management accounts and report to the Finance Manager. 
Maintain relationships with suppliers and provide general administrative support to the Group Finance team. 
Play an active role in the team, attending team meetings and contributing towards driving the department forward, embracing the cultural values and offerings valuable insights. 
Collaborate with the team to achieve goals in respect of the Atla Group strategy, offering support and insight from a finance perspective.
Ad-hoc tasks as and when requested.

Qualifications Required 
5 GCSEs or equivalent at grade C or above.
Part qualified ACCA/ACA status would be beneficial, but is not essential.

Experience and knowledge 
Previous experience in a similar role would be beneficial.

Notes
We are seeking an experienced Trust Manager to join our Client Services team. Reporting to the Client Director, you will be responsible for managing a portfolio of trust and company structures, delivering exceptional client service while ensuring the highest standards of governance, compliance, and fiduciary administration.
Key Responsibilities:
Manage the day-to-day administration of trust and company structures; build and maintain strong relationships with clients, intermediaries, and professional advisors; prepare and review governance documentation, including minutes, resolutions, and statutory filings; oversee client records, bookkeeping, financial administration, and coordination of accounts and tax reporting; ensure compliance with AML/CFT, sanctions, regulatory, and corporate governance requirements, and internal procedures; support client onboarding, business retention, and continuous improvement initiatives; manage a small team of client-facing staff members and provide coaching and technical guidance to junior team members.
About You
Professionally qualified (STEP, CGI/ICSA, ACA, ACCA or equivalent); proven experience in trust and company services within a regulated TCSP/fiduciary environment, with strong knowledge of corporate governance, and regulatory requirements; excellent organisational, communication, and stakeholder management skills, strong risk awareness, attention to detail, and problem-solving ability; experience reviewing financial information and maintaining high-quality client records.
Why Join Us?

The role: 
The Senior Digital Marketing Executive will provide support for the Markets and Marketing function as well as the wider CDs firm. The ideal candidate should be diligent and well-versed running social media campaign and assisting in maintaining and updating the Crown Dependencies website. The candidate should also be familiar with design software, such as Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop and InDesign. The person should have the ability to plan, execute and manage timelines excellently. The role will require communication to stakeholders at all levels.

Accountabilities:
Support the team with campaign production and execution where needed, from global thought leadership to local events.
Create emails to be distributed internally and externally.
General administration which might include helping event suppliers with invoices, managing the job tracker, managing data into our CRM system, manage email queries regarding events.
Assist with eMarketing, including use of our CRM system and sending emails externally.
Maintain and update the local Crown Dependencies website. This includes liaising with other departments to ensure that the information included is accurate to the services they provide.
Act as creative lead for the marketing team – includes overseeing design work done by other members of the team and ensure brand guideline compliance.
Creating and scheduling social media content for LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram posts that are in line with our brand guidelines and in terms of imagery and tone of voice.
Develop and manage social media campaigns, both organic and paid.
Efficiently analyse the performance of both social media and the website to inform decision-making of future digital marketing activities.
Provide training to other departments within the firm to ensure brand compliance of documents that are sent to clients / external stakeholders.
Other marketing tasks may be included as the candidate becomes familiar with the working environment and team.

Candidate requirements:
Ideally hold CIM professional qualification or equivalent, or have studied some sort of marketing, and/ or 4-5yrs experience working in a marketing role.
Strong networking and presentation skills.
Excellent experience running digital marketing campaigns.
Previous experience with Adobe software is advantageous.
An ability to express views and ideas articulately, from both a written and oral perspective.
Confident and independent personal skills.
Ability to multi-task, prioritise workloads and meet agreed timeframes.

Notes
We offer ICAEW or ACCA training contracts to motivated students who want to start a career where they can have a positive impact on their community whilst developing deep expertise and working with industry leaders.

As an audit trainee you will support engagement leaders by providing administrative and investigative support to ensure effective delivery of assignments in-line with client, statutory, legal and KPMG methodology.

You will be given formal structured professional study support, receive rewards as you pass exams and be exposed to industry leaders as you develop deep expertise of our Financial Services clients.

As an audit trainee you will be responsible for:

Delivering timely work with a focus on quality and efficiency.
Developing and maintaining effective relationships with all colleagues and clients.
Developing and understanding internal and external processes and procedures.
Proactively seeking feedback and opportunity to reflect upon tasks performed.
Applying the knowledge gained through professional studies to work completed.
The skills and experience you will need to thrive as an audit trainee:

Minimum B,B,C at A-level.
A 2:1 degree (or higher) if you are a graduate.
112 UCAS points (or equivalent).
5 GCSEs Grade A - C (including English and Mathematics).
The ability to work using initiative, prioritise tasks and adapt to developing business and departmental needs.
Excellent written and spoken English.
Be accountable for own work and career progression.
Proficient knowledge of Excel and other Microsoft Office programmes.
The advantages of growing your career with KPMG in the Crown Dependencies.

Direct access to leadership from your first day.
Rapid career progression for excellent performers.
Growing opportunities to advance in non-standard career routes as we continue to meet our ambitious growth targets.
Exposure to industry leaders in a Financial Services centre of excellence.
Thriving social networks.
Scenic island locations with little to no commuting time.
Safe, friendly communities.

For more details and to apply contact Khamon@kpmg.com

Notes
The Settlements Analyst will undertake the tasks carried out by the Settlements Team as allocated. The Settlements Team is responsible for the timely settlement of all investment transactions for the bank’s clients and our internal Treasury Department.

Responsibilities & Duties.
Trade settlement in multiple currencies across international markets.
Preparing documents and processing stock transfers.
Journal input and foreign exchange transactions.
Multi-currency cash and stock reconciliation query resolution.
Cross-training throughout the Settlements Team.
User Acceptance Testing for the Settlements Team, as and when required.
Proposing change in order to improve existing processes and systems.
Ensuring any settlement team errors or breaches are resolved promptly, with the required incident reporting and breach reporting completed timely and improvements identified to prevent reoccurrence.
Ensure procedures are kept up to date, as appropriate.
Ensure that any queries received are dealt with in a timely and appropriate manner keeping in regular communication with clients/relationship managers and updating them with regard to latest developments and progress towards the resolution of queries. Escalating where appropriate.
Undertaking ad hoc tasks as directed by the Settlements Manager.
Keep updating knowledge regarding international business policies and changes within the industry.
Keeping up to date with regulatory changes within the industry and ensuring measures are taken to comply.
Assist in project work as assigned by the Settlements Manager, delivering to any set timescales.
Provide support to the Settlements Manager and other team members.
Providing cover for other areas within the department where training has been received.
To safeguard client assets by ensuring client asset rules are followed for all appropriate jurisdictions.
?

Skills, Qualifications and Experience.
A minimum of two years in an investment operations role (desirable).
To have a good knowledge of investment administration activities, both technical and operational, with the ability to detect possible problems and provide solutions.
Previous experience in a dealing or settlements role would be advantageous but not necessary.
A minimum of 5 GCSE’s or equivalent, with a pass at grade C or higher, in Maths and English.
Holds or working towards a suitable investment administration qualification at level 3 or above, such as the CISI Investment Operations Certificate (IOC) or an equivalent investment related qualification.

Location: Glasgow or Isle of Man Barclays Campus with hybrid working options? 
Working Hours: You’ll work across a 24/7 rotating shift pattern, covering a mix of weekday and weekend shifts including evenings, nights and occasional afternoons to support global client needs. 
About the Role: 
We’re growing our team to better support our global market clients, extending our service beyond core business hours to meet their everyday banking needs.  
Join us as a Customer Service Advisor and be part of this next phase of growth.  
In this role, you’ll deliver a great experience for our clients as their first point of contact.  You’ll support them with their everyday banking needs, building strong relationships, developing your skills and growing your knowledge in a fast-paced, client-focused environment.
To apply - 
https://barclays.wd3.myworkdayjobs.com/External_Career_Site_Barclays/job/Glasgow-Campus/Customer-Service-Advisor--24-7-shift-pattern_JR-0000117716

Shift Pattern: 

Rotation across day, evening and overnight shift, including a mix of weekdays and weekend working. 
Typical shift times range between 20:00 – 06:30 and 22:15 – 09:00, with some afternoon and evening shifts (14:00 – 23:45). 
Built on an 8-week rotational cycle to provide variety and fairness across shifts.

What You’ll Be Doing 

Delivering client service across telephony and written channels. 
Building, trusted relationships by understanding needs and responding with empathy and professionalism. 
Supporting clients with their banking products and services, offering solutions that meet their circumstances. 
Listening carefully to understand and provide clear, accurate, and timely support. 
Working collaboratively with colleagues to deliver a consistent, high?quality experience.
Following policies and processes to maintain a strong risk and control environment.

Notes
About to Graduate?  
Finishing your PhD?
What Next?

From small businesses to some of the world’s best-known brands, our clients count on reliable financial statements, information and processes to inform their ongoing strategies. More than ever, business is about interpreting and reacting to complex data — and they look to us for advice and services they can trust every time. You’ll use your professional skills and experience to make it happen, handling complex audit procedures across the UKI industry sectors.

At EY in the Isle of Man, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.  

The opportunity:
EY’s practice in the Isle of Man is experiencing significant growth. Based in the heart of the Isle of Man, our UKI operation has enjoyed major business wins. With a huge welcome from our clients and increased demand from the UKI industry sectors, the Isle of Man is looking to recruit Graduate Trainee Chartered Accountants starting in August 2026.  

As an Graduate Trainee Chartered Accountant in the Isle of Man, you will be a fundamental part of a multi-disciplinary team, working closely with our clients delivering efficient and effective assurance services. What's more you won't always find yourself in a purely office-based role, as we encourage you to work with clients on their own sites when this is practical and efficient. If you are a confident team player, have excellent communications skills, and have a genuine interest in studying towards an accountancy qualification, consider EY.

Your key responsibilities:
You will be expected to execute work efficiently, delivering excellent service and bringing the full breadth of EY's capability to support our UKI industry sector clients. You will train towards obtaining your ACA professional qualification in a supportive and enthusiastic environment.

Preparing accurate assurance documentation for review.
Take ownership for nominated audit area(s) and/or delivery and completion of smaller clients.
Gaining an in-depth knowledge of the audit process to develop knowledge.
Complete work allocated by direct supervisor within budget and deadlines.
Gain knowledge on engagements of client/business issues, e.g. by using the firm's knowledge resources.
Gather and analyse data, and perform detailed audit testing.

Skills and attributes for success:
Strong motivation to study towards the ICAEW ACA qualification.

To qualify for the role you must have:
2:1 honours degree in any discipline.

We are looking to recruit experienced health care assistants to join our team at Silverdale Care Home. 
As a Health Care Assistant your role is to provide dignified and individualised support to older people who may require extra assistance. You will work as part of an established team providing support to our residents with day to day care. You will need to be a kind, caring individual who likes to provide care and support helping others. Principal Duties Include: To assist in providing highest standards of personal care and attention for the residents. To assist with personal hygiene as per care plan. Providing support at mealtimes, helping to serve meals, prepare tables. Promote independence and wellbeing of our residents. To be polite and helpful at all times i.e. appropriate conduct and attitude towards the residents, visitors and colleagues at all times.
We are offering day and night shifts (you will need to advise if you have a preference). This role is physically demanding but also provides the opportunity to learn and grow and ensure that our residents are provided with a high standard of person-centred care. A full induction programme will be provided upon commencement of employment. 
We provide an ongoing training programme throughout each year to promote professional development.
We will require an enhanced DBS check.  Uniform is provided. If you are interested in applying for this position, please contact Michelle on email office@silverdalecare.com to request the application form.

Notes
Crossroads are looking for an exceptional communicator  
who can offer support to carers who feel that they are  
not being heard. Your role will be to listen, understand,  
champion and work with carers to help them navigate  
the difficulties they encounter in their caring journey. 
This will involve supporting them to access and  
understand appropriate information and services,  
ensuring that they are taken seriously and their rights  
are respected.  
To do this you must be able to listen effectively, engage 
and build relationships with carers, other agencies and  
statutory bodies. You will need knowledge or be able to  
learn about the legislation and policies involved in the  
social care system. 
The successful applicant will? have excellent  
communication skills, the ability to maintain professional  
relationships (often with families in distress), keep calm  
under pressure and maintain confidentiality  
This is a part time position 14 hours per week. 
Qualifications and experience in the field of Social Care 
preferred but  
not essential as personality is key and training will be  
given. Applicants must have a clean driving licence and  
access to their own vehicle as meetings may be  
anywhere in the island. For more information or an  
application form please phone 673103 or email  
info@crossroadsiom.org or go to our website  
www.crossroadsiom.org 
Closing date is 11 August 2026

Notes
This is a full-time, permanent role (35 hours per week) based within the community across the Isle of Man. The post involves regular travel, including home visits, meetings, and the provision of direct support within local communities.

Due to the nature of the role, candidates must be based in the Isle of Man and hold a valid driving licence with access to a vehicle, as some locations can be difficult to reach using public transport.

This role plays an instrumental part in making strong trusted relationships with people affected by dementia, families and carers within communities and diverse groups to support them to attend workshops and focus groups or community networks, Alzheimer's Society have a commitment to working with people with lived experience. This ensures that we create and adapt our services to be meaningful and reflect the needs of our service users. This role helps to embed this value and a improve dementia awareness and inclusivity in our communities, businesses and with stakeholders. 

The successful individual will be working with the support of the team to ensure that individuals, local communities and health services have access to vital information about dementia support, ensuring that lived experience remains a real focus in local communities.

This is a highly rewarding and outward-facing role, focused on building strong relationships across diverse communities. You will engage and network with people at all levels—from senior healthcare professionals to people affected by dementia, their families and carers. Through community-specific workshops, awareness sessions and partnership working, you will help reduce health inequalities and improve access to dementia support across the Isle of Man.

You will be joining an established, knowledgeable and well-respected team, sharing learning, insight and best practice. Our work is rooted in communities, and we have built trusted relationships with local partners, professionals and people affected by dementia.

The service is recognised for its commitment to working collaboratively to ensure dementia support reaches those who need it most, including underrepresented and seldom-heard communities. This role involves significant time spent working directly in communities. You will identify opportunities to promote services, build trust, facilitate workshops and strengthen local networks to improve dementia awareness and support.

Applications to be made via website: https://careers.alzheimers.org.uk/vacancies/4007/community-development-coordinator.html

CARE CAFÉ CATERING ASSISTANT
25 hours per week on a Limited Term Appointment up to March 2027.
(Working Hours 9:30 to 14:45 with some flexibility required)

We have an exciting opportunity within a new commercial catering venture supporting Utmost with their onsite café. This role is an essential position within the café team; your contribution will directly support the success of the venture generating income for Hospice Isle of Man to help fund patient care.

You will need to have a passion for food, be able to deliver great customer service and have a flexible “can do” attitude. You will also have good communication skills and be able to work well under pressure in a busy café environment and manage a variety of tasks whilst remaining calm and productive. 
This role is offered on a part time basis for a limited term up to March 2026. There may be an opportunity to extend this term if the contract is renewed depending upon the success of this venture. An ability to be flexible on working hours to support leave or cover occasional out of hours requests would also be required. 
If you enjoy making a difference and wish to contribute to the wider Manx Community, then this could be the role for you!

Matthew Neary on 567524.

You can make a difference and directly contribute to the Manx community .
We offer 25 days annual leave per year (pro rata for part time employees).

Notes
Salary up to £75,000 DOE, Welcome Bonus up to £5,000 plus Relocation Allowance up to £5,000.

Are you looking for an equine-focused role that offers genuine professional fulfilment alongside an exceptional quality of life? We’re delighted to offer an exciting opportunity for an Equine Veterinary Surgeon to join our thriving practice on the beautiful Isle of Man. This is a varied and rewarding equine-only position, working within a supportive and experienced team where you’ll be encouraged to develop your clinical skills while enjoying a truly unique island lifestyle. For those considering relocation, we offer full support with moving to the Isle of Man, helping to make the transition as smooth and stress-free as possible so you can focus on settling into both your new role and your new home.

Looking for a better work–life balance?

We offer a genuinely flexible approach to working patterns and welcome both full-time and part-time applicants. The full-time role is 38 hours per week, worked over 4 or 5 days, with 1 in 4 Saturday mornings and approximately 1 in 10 nights and weekends on call. Work–life balance is a genuine priority here. You’ll benefit from a competitive salary, generous holiday allowance, and strong CPD support to help you continue developing your equine interests and expertise. Our flexible rota patterns are designed to work around real life — whether that’s school commitments, reduced hours during holidays, or a working pattern that better suits your lifestyle, we’re happy to fix or flex rotas wherever possible. 

Team & Facilities:

You’ll be joining a supportive, friendly and experienced team that values collaboration, mentorship, and a positive working culture. The wider clinical team includes 17 Veterinary Surgeons, 14 Registered Veterinary Nurses, and 20 dedicated support staff, with BVRA-registered members and certificate holders within the group. This equine-only role offers a varied and rewarding caseload, combining ambulatory work in the field with access to excellent facilities and modern diagnostic equipment, enabling you to practice high-quality, progressive equine medicine. You’ll be supported by a knowledgeable team and a learning-focused environment where professional development is actively encouraged and your ideas are valued.

Life on the Isle of Man:

Set against a backdrop of rolling hills, rugged coastlines, and open countryside, the Isle of Man offers a truly special way of life. You’ll become part of a welcoming, close-knit community with a vibrant cultural scene — from the world-famous TT races and music festivals to live shows, local breweries, and a thriving food scene. With endless opportunities for outdoor pursuits, including equestrian activities, cycling, wild swimming, and fitness, it’s easy to build a life here that’s as fulfilling outside of work as it is within it.

Apply via the IVC website or contact taylor.findlay@ivcevidensia.com

Quay Dental is seeking a newly qualified GDC-registered Dental Therapist to join our team from September 2026. We are a modern private dental clinic located in the heart of Douglas on the beautiful Isle of Man, committed to delivering exceptional patient care within a supportive and forward-thinking environment. This is an exciting opportunity for a highly motivated Clinician looking to further develop their skills, with mentorship from an experienced Principal Dentist who will provide ongoing guidance, training and support. The role is initially offered as a 12-month training position with the opportunity for a permanent role thereafter. As a Dental Therapist at Quay Dental, you will undertake the full scope of dental therapy within your competence, including intra-oral scanning, while providing hygiene and therapy treatments using the latest technology including air-polishing. Our vision is to provide a therapy-led approach to dental maintenance, with the Dental Therapist playing an integral role within the team. You will work closely alongside our Dentists and existing Therapist to provide maintenance and treatment appointments with full dental nurse support. There will also be the opportunity to undertake a Postgraduate Diploma programme to further enhance your clinical skills and knowledge. We offer a salary of £40,000 based on a four-day week, together with a bonus scheme, reimbursed GDC fees, up to six weeks holiday pro-rata including bank holidays, private healthcare insurance and postgraduate training support. Outside of work, you will enjoy the very best of coastal living on the scenic Isle of Man, with beaches, countryside, wildlife and excellent quality of life, alongside low crime, excellent schools and fantastic transport links to the UK. With a maximum upper tax bracket of just 21%, your earnings can go significantly further. To apply or arrange a confidential conversation, please contact careers@quaydental.co.uk

Notes
We are looking for an experienced, enthusiastic and approachable Catering Manager to join our team at The Milntown Estate and take responsibility for the day-to-day running and development of our front-of-house catering operation.
Our café is an important part of Milntown and is often the first point of contact for people visiting the Estate. We want someone who can lead and support our existing team, maintain the friendly and welcoming atmosphere, and help us continue to improve and grow the business.
The role will involve managing and supporting the front-of-house team, preparing rotas and ensuring appropriate staffing levels, maintaining excellent customer service, overseeing stock and ordering, managing costs and budgets, and looking for opportunities to increase sales and develop what we offer.
Milntown is also a busy events venue, so you will work alongside our Events & Marketing Manager and Head Chef to help plan and deliver the catering side of weddings, functions, wakes and other events held across the Estate.
Maintaining high standards will be an important part of the role. This includes food hygiene, health and safety, cleaning schedules and other relevant procedures and regulations, working together with the Head Chef where responsibilities are shared across the operation.
This is very much a hands-on role. We are looking for someone who enjoys being part of the team and is happy to get involved when needed, particularly during busy services, functions and events.
For a full recruitment pack and detailed job description, or if you would like to find out more about the role, please contact General Manager Adam Quayle at estateoffice@milntown.org.

R & B Catering Ltd is seeking an experienced Takeaway Manager to oversee the daily operations of our busy takeaway. The role involves managing kitchen and takeaway operations, supervising and supporting staff, preparing rotas, ordering stock and maintaining inventory levels, ensuring compliance with food hygiene and health and safety regulations, training and performance management, maintaining till and cash records, delivering excellent customer service, handling customer enquiries and complaints professionally, and liaising with suppliers and relevant local authorities where required.

Applicants should have previous experience in a restaurant or takeaway management role, strong leadership and organisational skills, a good understanding of food hygiene and health and safety requirements, and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment while maintaining high standards of customer service.

This is a full-time position (40 hours per week) with a salary of £26,000–£28,000 per annum, depending on experience. Flexibility is essential, as the successful candidate will be required to work evenings, weekends, late nights, public holidays, and other peak trading periods. Availability to work throughout the Isle of Man TT, Manx Grand Prix, Christmas, Easter, and other exceptionally busy periods is an essential requirement of the role, as is the ability to confidently manage customer interactions during busy service hours.

Please send your CV to rnbcateringltd@gmail.com.

Notes
We're Hiring!
Front of House Team Member.
South of the Island.

Are you a friendly, energetic people-person who loves great coffee, good food and even better company? Our cafe in the south of the island is on the lookout for a warm, reliable Front of House team member to join our small, close-knit crew. If you take pride in looking after guests and keeping a busy cafe running smoothly, we'd love to hear from you.
The Role:
Position: Front of House (FOH).
Hours: 30-40 hours per week (across weekdays and weekends).
Pay: Minimum wage.
Location: South of the island.
What You'll Be Doing:
As part of our Front of House team, your day-to-day will include:
Opening and closing of the cafe.
Greet, assist and seat guests.
Take customer orders efficiently and accurately and communicate orders to Back of House (BOH).
Provide a good level of customer service (including preparation of beverages and food).
Maintaining order within the cafe and adhere to required standards.
Setting of tables and assisting BOH with delivery of meals.
Co-ordination between FOH and BOH to maintain timely service.
Clearing of tables during service and cleaning of tables and surrounds post service.
Ensuring the outside deck, cafe, bar area and bathrooms are kept clean and maintained at appropriate hygiene standards and a professional image is always portrayed.
Ordering of beverage and snack stock from suppliers.
Inventory management – replenishment of beverages, snacks and condiments, including stock rotation.
Filing of delivery notes and invoices.
Monthly stocktaking of all FOH items.
Accurate recording of transactions and end of day cash-up and safe keeping of monies.
Replying to emails and telephonic bookings if required.
Receiving and accumulating general customer feedback.
Preparation of staff rosters and work scheduling.
Always maintain a professional appearance.
Performing any reasonable ad-hoc tasks requested by the Manager / Owners.
About You:
Previous hospitality or cafe experience preferred.
Own reliable transport is essential.
Warm, friendly and customer-focused.
Reliable, punctual and well-presented.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and as part of a team.
Good communication skills and a positive attitude.
Able to work flexible shifts, including weekends.
What We Offer:
A warm, supportive team and a relaxed island work environment.
Stable hours (30-40 per week) with a regular roster.
The chance to grow your hospitality skills in a busy, well-loved cafe.
How to Apply:
If this sounds like you, we'd love to meet you. Please email your CV and a short note about yourself to vacancies@bdc.im

Head Chef – Terminus Tavern
Lead Our Kitchen. Shape Our Food. Inspire Our Team.

The Terminus Tavern is seeking an experienced and ambitious Head Chef to lead our kitchen and drive our food offer forward. This is an opportunity to take ownership of a busy food-led operation, delivering exceptional standards whilst developing a talented team and contributing to the continued success of one of the Isle of Man's most established pub venues.

As Head Chef, you will be responsible for all aspects of kitchen performance, including food quality, team leadership, menu execution, stock control, profitability and compliance. Working closely with the General Manager and Operations Team, you will ensure every guest receives a consistently outstanding dining experience.

We're looking for a hands-on leader who is passionate about great food, thrives in a fast-paced environment and takes pride in building high-performing teams. You will bring strong culinary skills, sound commercial awareness and the ability to motivate and develop others while maintaining the highest standards of food safety and hygiene.

Previous experience as a Head Chef, Senior Sous Chef or Kitchen Manager within a quality pub, restaurant or hospitality environment is essential, along with a strong understanding of fresh food operations, kitchen management and team development.

In return, you'll have the opportunity to influence menus, support the growth of your team, and play a key role in shaping the future of food at the Terminus Tavern. This is an exciting role for someone who wants to make a genuine impact within a respected and growing hospitality business.

Apply here: https://careers.hb.im/job/head-chef-at-the-terminus-tavern-5973399?source=hb.im

Notes
The Claremont Full-Time.  
At The Claremont, we pride ourselves on delivering an exceptional dining experience for every guest. We're looking for a confident, hands-on F&B Supervisor to lead our front-of-house team, keep service running smoothly, and help maintain the high standards our guests expect.
ABOUT THE ROLE
As F&B Supervisor, you'll oversee daily restaurant operations, ensure high standards of food quality and customer care, and lead a team delivering excellent service. You'll also be expected to fulfil the duties of a Food & Beverage Assistant, setting the standard for the team by example. You'll report to the Duty Manager / Operations Manager.
WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING
Supervising and coordinating daily restaurant operations, ensuring the team performs effectively.
Maintaining high standards of food quality, hygiene, and customer service.
Assisting with training and scheduling front-of-house F&B staff.
Monitoring inventory levels and assisting with ordering supplies.
Handling guest enquiries, complaints, and feedback professionally, in person, by phone, and by email.
Managing the booking system, including table allocations, deposits, and pre-orders.
Liaising with the kitchen team on dietary requirements and special requests.
Supporting Conference & Events planning, from enquiries through to on-the-day operations.
Ensuring compliance with food hygiene, health & safety, and risk assessment requirements.
Assisting with financial management, including monitoring wastage and breakages.
WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
Previous experience in a food & beverage or front-of-house supervisory role.
A natural leader who motivates and supports a team.
Excellent customer service skills with a calm, professional manner.
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
Good working knowledge of food hygiene and health & safety practices.
A flexible, hands-on approach and willingness to work as part of the team.
WHY JOIN THE CLAREMONT
A supportive, close-knit team environment.
Opportunities for training and career development.
Uniform provided.
The chance to help shape an exceptional guest dining experience.

For more details and to apply contact recruitment@sleepwellhotels.com

Join a seafood?led kitchen on the Isle of Man’s west coast

The Boatyard is a busy, modern coastal restaurant on Peel harbour, known for fresh seafood, seasonal menus, and a warm, professional team culture. We’re looking for a talented Sous Chef to join our kitchen and help lead service with creativity, consistency, and pride.

The Role:
As Sous Chef, you’ll work closely with our Head Chef to deliver high?quality, seafood?focused dishes that celebrate local produce. You’ll take ownership of day?to?day kitchen operations, support junior chefs, and ensure every plate leaving the pass reflects our standards.

What We’re Looking For:
Strong experience in a professional kitchen, ideally with seafood, confidence running a section and leading service, a passion for fresh, local produce, good communication and leadership skills, high standards, attention to detail, and pride in your work, someone who thrives in a busy, supportive team environment. 

What We Offer:
Competitive pay based on experience, a supportive, friendly team and positive working culture, opportunities for progression and creative input, a beautiful coastal workplace with a strong local following.

If you’re a skilled chef who loves seafood, enjoys working with quality ingredients, and wants to be part of a respected harbour?side restaurant, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply with your CV and a short introduction why you would be ideal for this position, why include some photos of your food and tell us about your favourite dishes,  to fish@theboatyardpeel.com

Submit all lost property immediately to Reception in accordance with procedures.
Be fully familiar with and follow the hotel’s fire evacuation procedures.

The Bar Worker is responsible for delivering friendly, efficient service to customers while preparing and serving drinks to company standards. The role supports a clean, safe, and welcoming pub environment.

We’re looking for friendly and reliable people to join our bar teams across various Heron & Brearley pubs on the island. We have roles available in both wet-led pubs and pubs that also serve food. No experience is needed as full training is provided. 

Applicants must be 18 or over due to alcohol service.

What the job involves:

Serving drinks and looking after customers.
Supporting food service where required.
Keeping the bar area clean and safe.
Handling payments and using tills.
Working as part of a team during busy shifts. 
Working hours. 

Shift work, including evenings and weekends. Hours vary by site.

What we’re looking for:

Friendly and approachable attitude.
Good communication skills.
Reliability and good timekeeping.
Ability to stay calm when it’s busy.
Willingness to learn and help out where needed. 
Training provided. 

You’ll receive full training in bar service, customer service, responsible alcohol service, and food hygiene where relevant.

Locations: 

Positions are available across multiple Heron & Brearley pubs around the Isle of Man.

We are looking for a Trainee IT & Print Engineer to join our team and develop a career within IT, print technology and technical services. This is a varied, hands-on role that offers the opportunity to learn from experienced professionals whilst gaining valuable technical skills and industry-recognised training.

No previous engineering experience is required. We are looking for someone with a positive attitude, a willingness to learn and a genuine interest in technology.

What you will be doing:

Preparing and configuring printers and other devices before customer installation.
Delivering and installing equipment across the Isle of Man.
Supporting toner and consumables management for customers.
Assisting with the preparation and deployment of laptops and Apple devices.
Receiving, checking and organising stock within the warehouse.
Supporting inventory control and stocktake activities.
Learning our service desk and ticket management systems.
Providing excellent customer service both on-site and over the phone.

Typical working hours are a 37.5-hour week Monday to Friday.

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:
A keen interest in IT and technology.
Good practical and problem-solving skills.
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
A customer-focused approach.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Ideally a full driving licence.

What we offer:

Full training and ongoing support.
Manufacturer training with leading technology providers.
Opportunity to attend specialist training courses in the UK.
Exposure to a wide range of IT and print technologies.
Genuine career progression into technical engineering roles.
A varied role where no two days are the same.

This role would suit a college leaver, someone looking to start a career in IT or engineering, or an individual with customer service or technical experience who is looking for a new challenge.

Notes
Phantom Ltd, the Isle of Man software studio behind PhantomTrace and our KYC AI platform, working closely with Crossleys Forensics (a forensic accounting firm in the UHY international network), is hiring a Software Engineer to build and own some of our software end to end, from a rough idea through to a running service that people rely on. You would work across backend, deployment, and the day-to-day of keeping things healthy, design systems that are simple to run and simple for the next person to read, and integrate with third-party services such as KYC providers and forensic data sources. We build with AI agents every day, Claude Code and tools like it are central to how we work, so this role sits right in the middle of that.

We are looking for someone with strong backend engineering, real cloud and deployment experience (you can put a service into production and look after it), and a solid grounding in system design and engineering principles. You should be genuinely fluent with agentic development, meaning you have built real things with coding agents and understand context management, skills and subagents, prompting, and orchestration, with a clear view of where they help and where they get in the way. Good API design and integration skills matter too. Useful extras include some frontend and UI sense, various programming languages, and application security, and any exposure to forensics, compliance, fraud, or eGaming is a bonus rather than a requirement. What matters most to us is how fast you learn and whether your judgment holds up when the agent is confidently wrong. This is a full-time role based on the Isle of Man, and you must already have the right to live and work here.

To apply, send your CV and a short note about something you have built to hello@phantomstudios.io

About the role:
You'll own the day-to-day security operations of our corporate and cloud environments: hands-on, execution-focused work securing the tools, endpoints and infrastructure our teams rely on.
You'll implement and maintain our security posture across our productivity suite, device fleet, VPN and identity stack and cloud environment.
This is a build-and-harden role for someone who likes getting into the weeds. As you grow into it, there's a clear path toward owning the security function more broadly.
What you'll do:
Corporate & endpoint security
Administer and harden our identity and access stack, including password management and VPN/network-access tooling.
Configure and enforce device policies through mobile device management - disk encryption, screen-lock, patching baselines, app control and compliance rules across the fleet.
Manage endpoint protection and keep patching and vulnerability remediation on a predictable cadence.
Harden our productivity and collaboration suite: access controls, 2FA/MFA enforcement, admin roles and data-sharing/DLP settings.
Own onboarding/offboarding from a security angle - provisioning, de-provisioning and access reviews.
Cloud security.

Harden our AWS environment: IAM policies and least-privilege access, account and organisation guardrails, security groups and network segmentation.
Implement and monitor logging and detection.
Manage secrets, key management and encryption at rest and in transit.
Review infrastructure changes for security impact and work with engineering to close gaps.
Testing & assurance.

Run internal and continuous security testing: vulnerability scanning, configuration audits and attack-surface reviews.
Conduct hands-on internal penetration testing against our own systems where appropriate.
Scope, coordinate and manage external penetration-test vendors for formal independent assessments, then track and drive remediation of findings.
Maintain security documentation, run tabletop exercises and support our compliance and audit obligations.
What we're looking for:

Proven hands-on experience in security operations, IT security or cloud security engineering - someone who has actually configured MDM, hardened AWS, and administered identity tooling, not just written policy about it.
Solid working knowledge of Cloud security services and cloud hardening.
Comfortable across at least one MDM platform, a VPN/ZTNA solution and a password-management tool.
Practical familiarity with vulnerability scanning and penetration-testing tools and methodologies.
Scripting ability (Python, Bash or similar) for automation.
A methodical, ownership-driven mindset - you close loops and document as you go.

For more details and to apply visit: https://fortunatemedia.bamboohr.com/careers/100

What you’ll be doing:
As a Customer Journey Manager, you'll play a key role in crafting outstanding experiences for our customers and colleagues. You will work closely with Product Owners and cross-functional teams. Using data, insights, and advanced business analysis techniques, you will understand journey performance, find opportunities to improve, and turn your findings into meaningful results. Working within our Commercial Banking division, you'll help shape and optimise customer journeys that support the evolving needs of business and corporate customers.
Ensure customer needs remain central to decision-making by using both qualitative and quantitative insights to inform journey development, prioritisation, and product development. Collaborating with Product, Experience Design, Engineering, and operational teams, help build seamless end-to-end experiences that work flawlessly across functional boundaries.
Additionally, you'll support continuous improvement by defining problems, evaluating options, and crafting recommendations that improve customer outcomes, colleague experiences, and business performance. Your work will ensure that processes, systems, and technology solutions deliver the intended experiences.

What we’re looking for?
Data Analysis & Customer Insight – Minimum of 2 years analysing and interpreting data from various sources. These include transactional, behavioural, demographic, and operational data to produce valuable insights. This supports business decisions centred on the customer.

Notes
Our client seeks a Transaction Management Unit Manager to join their team. Role Profile: To independently implement and manage a range of complex Structured Corporate Loan transactions as intended by the loan agreement, in support of the IB business and Wholesale Clients clients. Key Responsibilities: Actively monitor, identify, investigate, resolve and / or escalate complex issues relating to the deal throughout the life of each live transaction and regularly communicate with stakeholders in order to maintain appropriate positions and efficient operations, ensure the transaction terms and conditions are adhered to by the client and / or third parties, provide a high-quality service, and mitigate operational risk. Collect and lodge all transaction collateral documentation (e.g. legal agreements, security agreements, share certificates) with the Collateral team for safe keeping and feed downstream calculations for capital management and credit risk mitigation. Coordinate with Legal, Credit and Collateral to approve and authorise various collateral (security) releases. Consult stakeholders, provide relevant operational expertise regarding complex Structured Loan transaction operational requirements into cross-functional enablement teams, provide approvals and participate in post product deployment reviews, to ensure the effective operation of new product development and smooth activations. Coordinate and inform stakeholders of the transaction close out when it reaches maturity, to ensure stakeholders are aligned, Wholesale Clients records are reliable and valid, and the capital management process is well supported. Where applicable, provide instructions to release all required collateral. Create complex transactions based on the salient features from the legal agreement to create an accounting record, enable the ongoing administration, monitoring and management of the facility and to facilitate ongoing reporting requirements. Key Skills and Experience: Educated to Degree Level (Business Commerce). 5 - 7 years experience in Operations. A track record adding value and delivering professional, client centric service to internal and /or external clients preferred. Experience working within Transaction Management in Financial Services supporting the Investment Banking business.
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16599

Notes
Purpose of the role: As a Senior VIP Manager, you will lead the management and growth of our High Value Customer (HVC) portfolio, delivering a personalised and premium customer experience. You will be responsible for developing VIP strategies that drive customer loyalty, retention and long-term value, while ensuring all activity is aligned with regulatory requirements and responsible gambling principles.
Key Responsibilities: Managing and growing a portfolio of High Value Customers, delivering a personalised and exceptional customer experience. Developing and implementing VIP acquisition, retention, reactivation and loyalty strategies to maximise customer engagement and value.•	Building and maintaining strong relationships with key customers through proactive communication and account management. Monitoring customer activity and identifying opportunities to increase player value while promoting sustainable and responsible play. Working closely with Responsible Gambling, Compliance and AML teams to ensure VIP activity meets all regulatory and internal requirements. Collaborating with CRM, Marketing, Payments, Customer Support, Trading and Product teams to deliver a seamless customer journey. Conducting affordability assessments, Source of Wealth (SoW) reviews and Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) processes where required. Analysing VIP performance, customer behaviour and campaign effectiveness, providing insights and recommendations to drive continuous improvement. Coaching and supporting Junior VIP Managers, helping to develop their skills, knowledge and performance. Reviewing and improving VIP processes, customer journeys and operational efficiencies to enhance the overall customer experience.

Skills & Experience: Proven experience managing High Value Customers within the online gaming industry. Strong understanding of VIP lifecycle management, customer retention and relationship management. Good knowledge of Responsible Gambling, Compliance and AML requirements. Strong commercial awareness with the ability to identify growth opportunities and maximise customer value. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build lasting customer relationships. Experience mentoring, coaching or supporting team members is advantageous. Fluent written and spoken English is essential; Mandarin language skills are highly desirable.

Our interviews are a two-way process, and we want you to have the time and opportunity to get to know us, as much as we are getting to know you! Our interviews are conversational, and we want to get the best from you, so come at us with questions and be curious. In the event that we receive sufficient applications for the role this vacancy may be subject to early closure. Therefore, if you are interested, please submit your application as early as possible. Apply via recruitment@mayflyentertainment.com

Notes
The Role.
The HR Manager will be a trusted adviser to the leadership team and employees, acting as the key link between people, managers and leadership. You'll help resolve challenges, strengthen relationships and foster a positive, high-performing culture.
This role goes beyond policies and procedures. We're looking for someone who enjoys working with people, communicates with empathy and confidence, and can balance individual needs with business objectives.
You will lead recruitment, support talent development and succession planning, and help ensure Ramsey Crookall remains a place where people choose to build long-term careers.
Key Responsibilities
Champion a positive, collaborative and inclusive workplace.
Build trusted relationships across the business.
Support employee engagement, wellbeing and high performance.
Provide practical HR advice to managers.
Manage employee relations matters with professionalism and discretion.
Coach managers and help resolve workplace issues fairly and consistently.
Lead recruitment across the business.
Deliver an excellent candidate experience.
Support interviewing, selection and future talent planning.
Identify future leaders and develop succession plans.
Support learning, coaching and career development opportunities.
Partner with the CEO and leadership team on people strategy.
Support workforce planning, organisational change and continuous improvement
Maintain HR policies and procedures.
Ensure compliance with Isle of Man employment legislation.
Oversee performance reviews, HR systems and employee records, and support payroll and benefits.
Skills & Experience
Essential
Experience in a senior HR generalist or HR Manager role.
Strong employee relations and recruitment experience.
Experience developing talent and succession plans.
Excellent communication, emotional intelligence and relationship-building skills.
Strong organisational skills, sound judgement and commercial awareness.
Desirable
CIPD (or equivalent) qualification.
Experience in professional or financial services.
Knowledge of Isle of Man and UK employment legislation.
We're looking for someone who is:
A genuine people person who enjoys helping others succeed.
Approachable, trustworthy and emotionally intelligent.
Calm, diplomatic and confident when handling sensitive situations.
Proactive, pragmatic and solutions-focused.
Collaborative, resilient and an excellent communicator.
Benefits
Competitive salary and performance-based bonus.
Comprehensive health benefits.
Non-contributory pension.
Professional development opportunities.
Free parking.
Please send your CV and a short supporting statement to hr@ramseycrookall.com by Tuesday 4 August 2026.

Notes
We are looking for a results focused Manager to join our Restructuring Advisory team at FRP Advisory (Isle of Man) Ltd. You will work on a wide range of assignments across both advisory and formal engagements. You will take a lead role in managing a portfolio of insolvency cases, including, liquidations, receiverships, CVL’s and MVL’s ensuring statutory compliance whilst being responsible for stakeholder engagement throughout.

You will manage a portfolio of insolvency cases, overseeing case progression from appointment through to closure while ensuring compliance with relevant insolvency legislation. The role requires the ability to manage multiple priorities and lead teams across concurrent projects, delegating work effectively, reviewing outputs, and providing technical guidance where required. You will liaise with a range of stakeholders including directors, creditors, legal advisors, accountants and agents, undertake investigations into financial and legal matters, and prepare high-quality reports and presentations for both internal and external audiences. In addition, you will support the development of team members, contribute to training initiatives, process improvements and technical updates, and apply strong analytical, problem-solving and commercial skills to identify risks, develop practical solutions and recognise opportunities to support client needs and business growth. A balance of strategic thinking, attention to detail and strong leadership capability will be essential for success in the role.

Copilot said:

We are looking for a degree-educated professional who holds a recognised accounting qualification such as ACA, ACCA or ICAS, and has demonstrable experience managing insolvency and advisory cases. The successful candidate will possess strong technical knowledge of insolvency legislation and procedures, coupled with excellent report-writing and communication skills. They will be commercially aware, able to identify opportunities and understand client needs, while also being capable of managing competing priorities and delivering high-quality work in a fast-paced environment. A proactive, analytical approach and the ability to exercise sound judgement under pressure are essential.

You can apply to the role using this link: https://smrtr.io/zZV-x
