We are looking to recruit a part-time receptionist, in our friendly, dynamic, busy private medical therapy clinic, in central Douglas.  The successful candidate must have a pleasant and courteous telephone manner, self motivation to work under their own initiative to support our therapists with all admin and clinic duties, and have a genuine desire to help our clients. The roles requires 24 – 37  hours work per week with a minimum of 3 full days per week (8.30am – 5.30pm).  
As the first point of contact for our clients, you will play a vital role in ensuring the smooth day-to-day running of the clinic. Your responsibilities will include: arranging client appointments, supporting clients to use our online services, taking client payments, generating receipts or invoices for insurance claims, handling confidential data, and communicating efficiently with other team members. The role will also include looking after our reception waiting areas, clinic stock, cleaning and be a friendly meet and greet presence to our visiting clients and customers. 
The successful candidate will have experience of Microsoft office systems, using an electronic appointment diary system and ideally have experience in a reception environment, working quickly when busy, whilst maintaining attention to detail. Please email jobs@rehablabphysio.co.uk for more information / job description AND to submit your application which must consist of your CV AND A COVERING LETTER to introduce yourself and express why you are suited for this role. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted by 14.08.26: after this date, please assume (with our thanks) that your application has been unsuccessful.

Notes
We are establishing a new conveyancing practice in the Isle of Man and are looking for an experienced Senior Conveyancing Administrator to join us at an early stage and play a key role in shaping how the business operates from the ground up.
This is a rare opportunity to be involved not just in day-to-day case management, but in building processes, systems, and standards for a modern, efficient conveyancing service.
About the Role:
You will bring strong hands-on experience of residential conveyancing on the Isle of Man, with a practical understanding of both purchases and sales, and how transactions are progressed locally from instruction through to completion.
Working closely with the founders, you will:
Manage conveyancing files from start to finish (sales and purchases).
Help design and implement efficient workflows and processes.
Support the set-up of systems, templates, and client procedures.
Act as a key operational point of knowledge within the business.
What We’re Looking For:
Proven experience in Isle of Man conveyancing (essential).
Strong administrative and organisational skills at a senior level.
Practical knowledge of the full conveyancing lifecycle (pre-contract to completion and post-completion).
Ability to work independently and take initiative in a start-up environment.
A pragmatic, solutions-focused approach.
What We Offer:
The opportunity to get involved at the outset of a new and growing practice.
A genuine chance to shape how the business operates.
A supportive and collaborative working environment.
Competitive remuneration, dependent on experience.
________________________________________
If you are an experienced conveyancing professional looking for something more than a traditional role—and want to be part of building something from scratch—we would welcome a conversation.

For more details and to apply contact anthony@knightconsultancy.co

Notes
As a Product Marketing Administrator, you'll help ensure IFGL's products and marketing materials remain accurate, up to date, and compliant with regulatory requirements. From maintaining product literature and supporting digital platforms to assisting with training initiatives and sales materials, you'll gain exposure to a wide range of product marketing activities.  This is a fantastic opportunity to take your first step into financial services, build a strong understanding of financial products, develop valuable technical and analytical skills, and collaborate with teams across the business.

The main duties for this role are:

Maintenance of the product literature suite ensuring timely and accurate updates where required.
Ensure the update of time-sensitive sales material including quarterly charge updates and time-limited special offers.
Support the development of the customer and adviser facing websites and internal gateway where product information is shown or stored.
Support regulatory updates or changes affecting products and literature.
Provide regular testing of illustration engines where product changes or charge information updates are required or occur.
Support and drive the development of the IFGL product training solution.
Provide support to stakeholders where product queries are received.
Monitor website traffic and prepare analytical reports to identify any required improvements or maintenance of hosted literature.

To ensure that this role is carried out to the desired level, the successful candidate should have the following skills and experience:

Have an interest in marketing and/or experience in the financial services industry.
Holds a minimum of 5 GCSEs A*-C including Maths and English.
Be proficient in Microsoft Office.
Possess strong organisational and planning skills.
Have excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Have an excellent level of numeracy. 
Be a confident and dedicated self-starter.
Have an excellent eye for detail due to the demands for maintaining product literature.

If you or you know someone who is interested in applying for this position, please forward a current CV with a covering letter to careers@ifg-ltd.com.

We encourage and welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds because we embrace diversity and inclusivity within our business.

Closing date for this vacancy will be 12 August 2026.

We currently have a permanent role available within our Investments Department for an Asset Servicing Senior Administrator.  The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring investment transactions are processed and accurately reflected on client policies following trade execution, helping to maintain accurate valuations and a seamless experience for policyholders and advisers.

Reporting to the Asset Servicing Team Manager, the key responsibilities of the role include:

Manage dividend processing activities, ensuring investment data is maintained accurately and in line with operational controls.
Oversee trade settlement activities, resolve exceptions and support the timely completion of market transactions, including complex cross-border settlements.
Administer corporate actions from notification through to completion, preparing communications and processing customer and adviser instructions accurately and efficiently.
Deliver excellent service to advisers, clients and colleagues by managing queries professionally and ensuring timely resolution of issues.
Maintain and update asset records, taking ownership of data quality and supporting the effective administration of investment assets.
Investigate and resolve reconciliation discrepancies, working with custodians and internal stakeholders to maintain accurate financial records. 
Support the monitoring and reconciliation of investment cash positions, identifying and resolving queries to ensure data integrity.
Support the Asset Servicing Team Manager with process, procedure and system improvements that enhance operational efficiency and control.

To be successful in this role, candidates should possess the following skills and experience:

Experience within an operational, settlements, reconciliation or corporate-action environment
5 GCSEs (or equivalent) grade C or above - including English and Maths
Strong numeracy, accuracy and attention to detail
Ability to work effectively under pressure and manage competing deadlines
Good planning and organisational skills
Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel
Certificate or interest in studying for CISI examinations is advantageous
Previous experience supporting junior colleagues or acting as a process reference point would be beneficial

We encourage and welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds because we embrace diversity and inclusivity within our business.
If you, or you know someone who is interested in applying for this position, please forward a current CV with a covering letter to careers@ifg-ltd.com 
Closing date for this vacancy will be 7 August 2026.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with strong analytical skills, a keen interest in Finance & Systems, and a proactive approach to improving processes and supporting change in an organisation where we care about each other, our customers and our community.

In this role, you will support the delivery of business-as-usual activity across Finance, help maintain system integrity, manage finance system processes and user access, and contribute to finance and Group-wide projects. You will work closely with colleagues across the business to resolve queries, support systems administration, and identify opportunities to improve the way Finance operates.

The main duties for the role holder will include:
Provide day-to-day support to the Finance function, including user access, chart of accounts updates and general finance system queries.
Take a lead role in the administration of the Group purchase order system, including system set-up, authorisation hierarchies and process improvements.
Support the bespoke Finance Data Hub solution and help ensure finance data remains accurate, accessible and well controlled.
Contribute to finance-specific and Group-wide projects, including requirements gathering, development, testing and implementation activity.
Review existing finance processes and systems, making recommendations that improve efficiency, control and user experience.
Support the implementation and upgrade of accounting systems, controls and procedures.
Assist with the reconciliation of system control accounts, analysing results, liaising with stakeholders and supporting corrective action where needed.

To ensure that this role is carried out to the desired level, the successful candidate will need the following skills and experience:
Experience using or administering finance systems, accounting packages or financial reconciliation systems.
Strong analytical and numerical skills, with the ability to interpret and work with large volumes of data.
Good knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
Good organisational and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work accurately and meet deadlines.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
The ability to build effective working relationships with colleagues and internal and external stakeholders.
Knowledge of databases, SQL Server Management Studio, the policy lifecycle, or experience in Life and Pensions or Financial Services would be advantageous.
A relevant professional qualification such as AAT, ACCA or equivalent, or a willingness to continue developing relevant finance and systems knowledge.

If you, or you know someone who is interested in applying for this position, please forward your current CV with a covering letter to careers@ifg-ltd.com

Notes
Not sure what “trust and corporate services” even means yet? That’s fine – most of our best people at Sentient International didn’t either when they started.

This is a genuine first-step career opportunity, not just a job. No experience, no jargon knowledge, no problem – we’ll teach you everything from the ground up.

The role

You’ll join our Client Services team and start learning the ropes of company and trust administration – real client work from day one, with someone experienced showing you how it’s done every step of the way.

It’s varied, it’s hands-on, and there’s always someone to ask if you’re not sure.

You’ll be involved in things like:

Helping set up and maintain company and trust structures for clients.
Preparing and maintaining company and trust records and documentation.
Preparing minutes and resolutions.
Preparing and filing statutory returns.
Working with our Compliance team on client due diligence.
Talking to clients and answering their queries.
Getting stuck into general office and admin tasks as part of the team.
What we’re looking for
You don’t need a background in finance or law – we’re far more interested in your attitude and potential than your CV.

We’re looking for someone who:

Is organised and good at managing their time.
Pays close attention to detail and gets things right.
Communicates clearly, in writing and in person.
Is keen to learn and not afraid to ask questions.
Works well with others and pulls their weight as part of a team.

No previous industry experience is required – full training and ongoing support is built into the role from day one.

For more details and to apply contact iom@sentientinternational.com

Are you looking for something a little different for the next 12 months? Our client is a technology company that provides a white-label online platform for a wide range of adult and mainstream dating brands. Shift work- all shifts include weekend work. The Role: To moderate content to ensure the safety of members and compliance of site rules. To also rate that content from a commercial perspective. The goal is for members to enjoy meeting like-minded people online in a safe manner. To this end, moderators: Look for any content that could shock or offend other members. Look for anything that could be a risk to the business. There are scammers on any dating site - help weed them out. Think of and watch out for the little things that members may forget when not considering the consequences of the things they post. This could be something as small as the tag on their pet's collar that shows a name, address or phone number, the logo on their shirt that says where they work, or the licence plate on their car. Stop people knocking on their door, calling their phone, or bombarding social media as a result of a member mistakenly posting their personal details online. Key Responsibilities: Performing moderation of submitted user content to determine suitability and commerciality, in accordance with site terms and conditions. This content includes: Profile headers and descriptions. Media (photos and videos). Blog posts. Forum posts. Comments on other member posts and videos. Key Skills and Experience: An open mind. Great attention to detail. Ability to multitask, prioritise, and manage time effectively. Bit of a detective by nature. Students welcome, but you will need to be 18+. No experience required, as training will be provided, however you will need to be computer literate. Shifts: Sunday 4:00 PM - 2:00 AM.Monday 4:00 PM - 2.00AM.Wednesday 4.00PM - 2.00AM. Control Room Operator.

Manx Automobile Assistance – Isle of Man.
Stoney Mountain Road, Foxdale.

** Full-Time or Part-Time **

Manx Automobile Assistance is a trusted vehicle recovery and roadside assistance provider serving customers across the Isle of Man. We pride ourselves on delivering a professional, reliable, and customer-focused service 24 hours a day.

We are looking for a calm, organised, and proactive Control Room Operator to join our growing team. You will be the first point of contact for customers requiring roadside assistance and recovery services, ensuring that help is dispatched quickly, efficiently, and professionally.

The Role:

As a Control Room Operator, you will play a vital role in coordinating our roadside assistance and recovery operations. You will manage incoming calls, liaise with customers and recovery technicians, dispatch the appropriate resources, and monitor jobs through to completion.
This position requires excellent communication skills, strong decision-making abilities, and the confidence to remain calm under pressure while managing multiple tasks simultaneously.

Key Responsibilities:

Answer and manage incoming calls from customers requiring roadside assistance and vehicle recovery.
Coordinate and dispatch recovery operators and technicians to incidents across the Isle of Man.
Monitor the progress of active jobs and provide updates to customers where required.
Ensure accurate recording of all customer and job information.
Maintain detailed logs and operational records.
Communicate effectively with drivers, technicians, customers, and business partners.
Prioritise workload and respond quickly to changing situations.
Support the smooth day-to-day running of the control room.
Assist with general administration duties including filing, invoicing, and data entry.
Contribute to continuous improvements within the business and support new operational processes when required.

What We're Looking For -

Essential Skills & Qualities:
Excellent customer service and communication skills.
Ability to remain calm and professional in high-pressure situations.
Strong organisational and multitasking abilities.
Good problem-solving and decision-making skills.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Competent computer skills, including Microsoft Office applications.
A proactive and flexible approach to work.

What We Offer:

Monday to Friday working pattern.
Competitive salary based on experience.
32 days holiday per year.
Full training provided.
Supportive and friendly working environment.
Opportunity to be part of a growing Isle of Man business with an excellent reputation.

To apply, please send your CV and a covering letter to – Timcole@manxaa.com

We are looking for a calm, organised, and proactive Control Room Operator to join our growing team. You will be the first point of contact for customers requiring roadside assistance and recovery services, ensuring that help is dispatched quickly, efficiently, and professionally.

The Role:

As a Control Room Operator, you will play a vital role in coordinating our roadside assistance and recovery operations. You will manage incoming calls, liaise with customers and recovery technicians, dispatch the appropriate resources, and monitor jobs through to completion.
This position requires excellent communication skills, strong decision-making abilities, and the confidence to remain calm under pressure while managing multiple tasks simultaneously.

Key Responsibilities:

Answer and manage incoming calls from customers requiring roadside assistance and vehicle recovery.
Coordinate and dispatch recovery operators and technicians to incidents across the Isle of Man.
Monitor the progress of active jobs and provide updates to customers where required.
Ensure accurate recording of all customer and job information.
Maintain detailed logs and operational records.
Communicate effectively with drivers, technicians, customers, and business partners.
Prioritise workload and respond quickly to changing situations.
Support the smooth day-to-day running of the control room.
Assist with general administration duties including filing, invoicing, and data entry.
Contribute to continuous improvements within the business and support new operational processes when required.

What We're Looking For -

Essential Skills & Qualities:
Excellent customer service and communication skills.
Ability to remain calm and professional in high-pressure situations.
Strong organisational and multitasking abilities.
Good problem-solving and decision-making skills.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Competent computer skills, including Microsoft Office applications.
A proactive and flexible approach to work.

What We Offer:

Monday to Friday working pattern.
Competitive salary based on experience.
32 days holiday per year.
Full training provided.
Supportive and friendly working environment.
Opportunity to be part of a growing Isle of Man business with an excellent reputation.

To apply, please send your CV and a covering letter to – Timcole@manxaa.com

The position will suit someone who is willing to work with the existing team and learn about maintaining and developing the nursery facilities. Nursery workers will also need to  learn about professional practices and standards of propagation and growing on. Nursery work can be both repetitive where large jobs can last for several days  and dynamic where several jobs are undertaken each day. The role will suit people who have a genuine interest to learn about plants, cultivation and can perform consistently throughout the year. 
This is a great chance to get involved in a significant, long - term project with opportunities to develop your knowledge and skills through on-the-job training while working with experts and distance learning.

We're looking for an experienced and motivated fitness coach to join the team at FitBody Fitness, delivering high-quality small group personal training sessions to our members. The main focus of the role is coaching small groups through structured, progressive programming, making sure every client trains safely, stays motivated and keeps moving towards their goals session after session. You'll also be responsible for inducting new members, taking them through their initial assessments and helping them settle in so they feel confident and supported from day one. Just as important is the work that happens between sessions, with regular check-ins to keep clients accountable on their training, nutrition and lifestyle, building the kind of relationships that keep people engaged and coming back. The ideal candidate holds a recognised Level 3 personal training qualification, has genuine experience coaching groups rather than only one-to-one, and brings the energy, reliability and communication skills needed to lead a room full of different abilities. You'll need to be organised, personable and genuinely invested in getting results for the people you coach. To apply, send your CV along with a short note about your coaching experience and why you'd be a good fit for FitBody Fitness to Darren@fitbodyfitness.im@hotmail.com

Are you passionate about animal welfare, hands-on outdoor work, and making a real difference in young lives?

At The Children’s Centre, we harness the power of nature, animals, and hands-on farm activities to create supportive, nurturing environments for children and young people across the island. We are looking for a practical, self-motivated, and reliable Farm & Horticulture Assistant to join our team.

In this varied role, you will lead on animal care at our farm, collaborate closely with our Horticulturalist to nurture our polytunnels and vegetable patches, and ensure our outdoor spaces are vibrant, safe, and productive.

What You’ll Be Doing:
Animal Husbandry & Care: Taking overall responsibility for the health and daily care of all farm animals—from daily feeding, habitat care and rotas to liaising with vets, farriers, and specialist departments.
Horticulture Support: Working side-by-side with our Horticulturalist to plant, tend, and harvest fresh produce across our polytunnels and vegetable beds.
Rota & Supply Management: Coordinating weekday and weekend feeding cover, sourcing quality animal feed and bedding, and managing farm logistics.
Cross-Team Collaboration: Working across all departments to support charitable initiatives and income-generation events on-site.
Who We’re Looking For:
Hands-on & Resilient: You love working outdoors, whatever the weather, and are comfortable with autonomous, physically active work.
Strong Communicator: Clear, open communication is key—whether you're coordinating weekend feeding rotas or liaising with external vets and internal teams.
Highly Organized: Excellent time management and the initiative to take sole responsibility for animals and operational tasks.
Team Player: Happy to work independently, yet eager to support the wider goals of the Income Generation and Development team

If you're ready to combine practical farm care with meaningful community impact, we’d love to hear from you! Please submit your CV and a cover letter explaining why you're a great fit for the role to HR@thechildrenscentre.org.im.

Are you passionate about animal welfare, hands-on outdoor work, and making a real difference in young lives?

At The Children’s Centre, we harness the power of nature, animals, and hands-on farm activities to create supportive, nurturing environments for children and young people across the island. We are looking for a practical, self-motivated, and reliable Farm & Horticulture Assistant to join our team.

In this varied role, you will lead on animal care at our farm, collaborate closely with our Horticulturalist to nurture our polytunnels and vegetable patches, and ensure our outdoor spaces are vibrant, safe, and productive.

What You’ll Be Doing:
Animal Husbandry & Care: Taking overall responsibility for the health and daily care of all farm animals—from daily feeding, habitat care and rotas to liaising with vets, farriers, and specialist departments.
Horticulture Support: Working side-by-side with our Horticulturalist to plant, tend, and harvest fresh produce across our polytunnels and vegetable beds.
Rota & Supply Management: Coordinating weekday and weekend feeding cover, sourcing quality animal feed and bedding, and managing farm logistics.
Cross-Team Collaboration: Working across all departments to support charitable initiatives and income-generation events on-site.
Who We’re Looking For:
Hands-on & Resilient: You love working outdoors, whatever the weather, and are comfortable with autonomous, physically active work.
Strong Communicator: Clear, open communication is key—whether you're coordinating weekend feeding rotas or liaising with external vets and internal teams.
Highly Organized: Excellent time management and the initiative to take sole responsibility for animals and operational tasks.
Team Player: Happy to work independently, yet eager to support the wider goals of the Income Generation and Development team

If you're ready to combine practical farm care with meaningful community impact, we’d love to hear from you! Please submit your CV and a cover letter explaining why you're a great fit for the role to HR@thechildrenscentre.org.im.

Notes
We are recruiting for an Assistant Chief Officer (Environment) to join the Environment & Regeneration Department to support and participate in the overall leadership of the Department.  The postholder will support the Director of Environment & Regeneration and will lead, plan and control the operation and staff of the Environment Section which includes Fleet Services & Stores, Waste Services, and Electrical Services and Engineering.  You will be the Council’s lead officer on construction/civil projects and will also be the Premises Manager for the Operational depot. 

Applicants must have extensive experience of construction/civil/engineering development either within the public or private sector.  Prior knowledge and experience of how corporate and support teams are established and operated is essential particularly in relation to strategy and communication.  Applicants will also need to be able to demonstrate senior leadership experience at Head of Department/Service level or equivalent.  We are looking for a senior leader who can drive the operation forward, think strategically and influence change whilst inspiring colleagues through clear communication.  

You must be a highly motivated self-starter and resilient with strong interpersonal and communication skills and have the ability to interface with all levels.  Solid stakeholder management, relationship building and influencing skills are a must as well as excellent organisational, technical, analytical and program and project management skills.  You must also have the ability to think strategically and be able to identify core issues and potential solution strategies in this demanding role.  

As a key member of the Department’s Senior Management Team, and a member of the Extended Chief Officers’ Management Team, the role is a vital part of the Department and of the Council as a whole in supporting the effective leadership of the organisation.  Delivering services in a sustainable way will be a key emphasis of this role, supporting the whole Council in achieving its low carbon ambitions and delivery of the Corporate Plan.

If you have substantial experience and success in managing at a senior level and can demonstrate a track record of delivery of high quality services within either the public or private sectors then we would like to hear from you!  

For an informal discussion about the position, please email khiggins@douglas.gov.im in order to arrange a call with Iain Jackson, Director of Environment & Regeneration.  

Application form and job description: downloaded at www.douglas.im.  Closing date for submission of completed applications is Friday, 14th August 2026.

Car Sales Executive – Full Time.

Manx Car Store is a highly respected, family?run used car dealership on the Isle of Man, known for offering an exceptional range of vehicles—from reliable family cars to premium high?performance models. Due to continued growth, we are seeking a motivated and professional Car Sales Executive to join our successful team.

About the Role:
We are looking for a proactive, confident individual with a strong background in sales. Previous experience within the motor trade or car sales is highly preferred; however, we are also open to candidates with solid general sales experience who are excellent on the phone, strong face?to?face with customers, and driven to succeed. The ideal candidate will be articulate, IT?literate, well?presented, and able to deliver outstanding customer service at every stage of the sales process.

Key responsibilities include, Providing exceptional customer service and maintain a professional, welcoming showroom environment, build trust and rapport with customers through face?to?face, phone, and digital communication, maintain strong product knowledge of current stock and incoming vehicles, conduct vehicle test drives and accurately evaluate part exchanges, consistently achieve and exceed sales targets while upholding high customer care standards, ensure vehicles are fully prepared and ready for customer handover. advise customers on suitable finance options, warranties, and accessories, assist with website management, marketing activities, and uploading new stock, manage customer enquiries pre? and post?sale with professionalism and efficiency, work collaboratively with colleagues to maintain a positive, high?performing sales environment.

Experience & Skills Required:
1–2 years sales experience (motor trade experience strongly preferred).
Confident communicator with excellent phone and face?to?face customer skills.
Highly motivated, target?driven, and able to work independently.
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
IT literate and comfortable using CRM systems and online platforms.
A genuine people person with a positive, professional attitude.
Minimum age 21 with a clean full UK driving licence (insurance requirement).

How to Apply:
Please email your CV to: tony.dhadwal@manxcarstore.com / sharne.bradley@manxcarstore.com

Van Mossel Jacksons are looking for an experienced Brand Manager in premium sales of motor vehicles (BYD & Volvo) to join their dedicated team. Working within Jacksons you will be skilled and seasoned Brand Manager in the sales of our current brands of premium new and preowned vehicles.

**Some of the responsibilities for the Brand Manager position are, but not limited to;**

Engage in the art of following up with both loyal and potential customers, nurturing relationships to bring about further transactions. 
Strive to meet and exceed monthly targets for the sale of both new and used cars. 
Seek out and approach new clients with steadfast determination, arranging meetings to understand and address their needs.
Achieve monthly sales targets for New and Used vehicles, achieving the minimum profit targets.
Achieve monthly sales targets for additional profit centres including finance.
Return correspondence from customers and ensure all matters of paperwork are tended to with diligence.
Seize every opportunity to maximise sales whilst ensuring complete customer satisfaction.

**The Brand Manager position comes with an excellent remuneration and other benefits;**

Starting Salary & excellent bonus scheme
Guaranteed Income: A generous sum guaranteed for the first three months as you train and settle in the new role.
Company Car: A desirable chariot. 
Training and Accreditation: To make sure you are developed to reach the highest level of commission.

**Requirements:**
You must possess experience in the sales, a requirement without compromise.
Knowledge of the Kerridge/ADP DMS system a benefit.
The gift of clear communication, both by phone and in person, is essential.
A valid Driving Licence.
Highly presentable, ambitious and target driven, you will have a strong passion for car sales in order to meet and exceed agreed targets for the sale of vehicles and related products.

For more details and to apply contact recruitment@jacksons.je

If you're looking for a role that enables you to make a real impact every day, this could be the opportunity for you.

Are you someone who enjoys hands-on work, thrives in a laboratory environment, and takes pride in doing things with accuracy and care? We’re looking for a Production Technician to join our team and play a key role in manufacturing high-quality chromatography products that support important scientific and commercial outcomes.
This is more than just a production role — it’s an opportunity to contribute to continuous improvement, process optimisation, and innovation in a regulated, high-performing environment.
This role will be a Fixed Term Contract.
You’ll be at the heart of our manufacturing operations, helping ensure our products are produced safely, efficiently, and to the highest standards. Your responsibilities will include:
Manufacturing chromatography products, intermediates, and base materials.
Following established SOPs and production methods with precision.
Recording production data accurately and maintaining detailed documentation.
Carrying out on-line quality control checks and identifying any anomalies early.
Supporting process optimisation and improvement initiatives.
Maintaining equipment and ensuring a clean, safe working environment.
What we’re looking for:
We’re looking for someone who is practical, detail-focused, and proactive, with a genuine interest in laboratory-based manufacturing.
You’ll thrive in this role if you are:
A strong team player with good communication skills.
Highly organised with excellent attention to detail.
Comfortable working both independently and as part of a team.
A natural problem solver who can spot issues early.
Able to follow processes accurately while also contributing ideas for improvement.
This is a hands-on, laboratory-based role where no two days are quite the same. You can expect:
A physically active role involving standing, lifting, and equipment operation.
A structured environment with a strong focus on quality and safety.
24/7 shift patterns supporting continuous operations.
To apply please follow this link - https://biotage-1708019070.teamtailor.com/jobs/7453461-production-chemist-astrea-bioseparations-fixed-term-contract

This is more than just a production role — it’s an opportunity to contribute to continuous improvement, process optimisation, and innovation in a regulated, high-performing environment.

What you’ll be doing - You’ll be at the heart of our manufacturing operations, helping ensure our products are produced safely, efficiently, and to the highest standards. Product Development Responsibilities:
Concept Development - collaborate with designers to translate initial sketches and ideas into feasible products.
Conduct research and be proactive in suggesting possible development to client.
Material Sourcing - work with suppliers to buy yarn and negotiate prices. 
Technical Development - ensure that the tech packs are clear and comprehensive for Albion to follow.
Collaborate with the Stoll Programming Team on all product development sent by clients, ensuring all requirements are understood and acted upon.
Create costing sheets to determine pricing for clients. Analyse product costs and work to keep them within budget while maintaining quality.
Oversee product checks during the development, pre-production, and bulk production stages to ensure client specifications are met.
Ensure all necessary information for client invoicing is provided to the finance department promptly for timely invoicing.
Create comprehensive range plans, including pictures, yarn details, garment weight, gauge, machine, total quantity ordered, and any other relevant information.
Order all necessary items listed on the Bill of Materials (BOMs) according to client requirements.
Liaise with yarn suppliers to obtain yarn prices, sample yarn, and bulk yarn.
Communicate any potential intellectual property (I.P.) infringements to the production staff.
Take receipt of and distribute all client Purchase Contracts and Purchase Order forms to relevant internal staff.
Issue production instructions to the manufacturing departments.
Communicate specific packing requirements from clients to the packing department.
Stay up to date with yarn and knitwear trends and relay this information to clients during meetings.
Create development swatches and prototypes to present to clients to generate additional business.
Handle general administration duties required for all launches, including record-keeping, mainly using Excel.
Skills and Qualifications:
Technical Knowledge - understanding of garment construction, knitting techniques, technical knitting including tech packs and material properties.
Attention to Detail - ensuring that every aspect of the product meets the required standards.
Communication - effectively collaborating with designers, suppliers, and colleague in Albion shop floor.
Problem Solving - addressing and resolving issues that arise during the development process.
Project Management - managing timelines, costs, and resources efficient.
Comfortable communicating clearly and concisely with all levels of the company. 
Advanced proficiency in Excel and strong organizational skills.
Strong ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple projects efficiently.

For more details and to apply contact rippal@albionknit.com
